title: Finite cohomological dimension on affine-diagonal schemes
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact scheme over a field k with affine diagonal [def-weil-field] [def-pc-scheme]. There is an integer d_X >= 0 such that H^p(X,F)=0 for every quasi-coherent O_X-module F [pqf-def-coherent] and every p>d_X.
